# Fil Solar Depot

> Supplier of high-efficiency bifacial solar panels and mounting systems in the Philippines, backed by HE & SONS, a 50-year-old Chevron Lubricants distributor. Free consultation, site survey, and system design. Order online and pay by GCash, QR Ph, or bank transfer.

## Products
- Canadian Solar 625W Bifacial panel
- Jinko Solar 590W Bifacial panel
- Hestia 650W Bifacial Double Glass panel
- Aluminum mounting rail
- Batteries and inverters (models to be announced)

## Services
- Free consultation, free site survey, free system design and quote
- Net metering assistance, delivery, warranty claim support, maintenance and cleaning
- Installation through partner: SOLAR HE and Sons (https://totoantonio.github.io/solarpowerinstall/)

## Key facts
- Team: TESDA-trained solar panel specialists in technical support, warehouse, and sales
- Backing: HE & SONS, 50 years in business as a Chevron Lubricants distributor
- Warranty: manufacturer warranties up to 15 years product and 30 years power output; Fil Solar Depot files and follows up claims
- Payment: GCash, QR Ph, bank transfer; online order form with printable order summary
- Email: info@filsolardepot.com
